step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify actors at the top of the diagram: Pathologist/Doctor icon (UserCompanyDomainExpert) and Hospital icon (UserConsumerHospital).
2. Identify AWS services on the whiteboard: Left S3 bucket for incoming/enriched medical image storage, EKS (Kubernetes platform for labeling and viewing results), SageMaker (for model training), Right S3 bucket (for trained models/results), FSX (high-performance file storage attached to SageMaker), and IAM (for identity and access control attached to SageMaker).
3. Trace data flows from visual arrows and transcript: Hospitals upload images to the Left S3 bucket. EKS ingests data from Left S3 where Pathologists (UserCompanyDomainExpert) annotate images. Enriched data from S3/EKS is sent to SageMaker for model training (leveraging FSx for high I/O and IAM for security). SageMaker exports the trained model to the Right S3 bucket, which feeds back into EKS for model validation.
